states: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

Karnataka.label: North Karnataka
Karnataka.dishes: jolada rotti (jowar flatbread), girmit, ennegayi, mirchi bajji, shenga chutney pudi
Karnataka.nonVegDishes: chicken or mutton curry with jolada rotti, kheema (minced mutton) with rotti, egg curry, fried river fish
breakfasts: jolada rotti with chutney pudi and curd

Karnataka.label: South Karnataka
Karnataka.dishes: ragi mudde with saaru, bisi bele bath, akki rotti, puliyogare, vangi bath
Karnataka.nonVegDishes: natti koli saaru (country chicken curry) with ragi mudde, donne biryani, mutton or chicken kheema, chicken pepper fry, mutton chops

Karnataka.label: Coastal Karnataka
Karnataka.dishes: neer dosa, kori rotti, Mangalorean fish or chicken curry, ghee roast, patrode
Karnataka.nonVegDishes: meen saaru (fish curry), kori rotti with chicken curry, chicken ghee roast, Kundapur chicken sukka, bangude (mackerel) fry, prawn gassi
breakfasts: kotte kadubu (steamed idli in jackfruit leaf)

diets.label: Non-vegetarian
diets.hint: Meat, fish and eggs are fine
